title: Choose the visual world for the Sunbae landing page
question: The roll assigned 모집공고 (the Korean recruitment-notice world). Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: 모집공고 · Recruitment Notice
options.lineage: Korean 채용공고 tables: 사람인·잡코리아 listings and corporate 공채 notices
options.thesis: The landing page is itself a recruitment notice: 후배 모집 and 선배 모집 side by side, written in the exact table grammar every 취준생 reads daily.
options.viewport: A full-width notice band (선배 · 2026 하반기 모집공고), then two equal 모집부문 columns, 후배 and 선배, each a ruled table of 자격요건 / 우대사항 / 크레딧 / 접수기간 with a live D-day and its own 지원하기 action; the live specialist table starts directly below as posting rows.
options.risk: Reads as a job board if the first line does not say consultation, and dense tables need real care on mobile.

raised.raise: One material owns the whole first viewport: the notice is a single continuous document, no hero-then-cards split.
Exactly one ink, one paper, one notice navy, one deadline red; hierarchy comes from rules and inversion, never extra color.
Every specialist row carries the same fixed data band: 리뷰 · 평균 · 배율 · 크레딧 · 다음 가능 D-day.
All landing motion runs on one orchestrated timeline (D-day ticks, rows filling, the 접수 stamp); reduced motion shows the final keyframe.
States print themselves as text inside the table (예약 가능 · 마감 · 검토 중), never as floating chrome.
One strict column grid governs the entire page; captions and buttons sit on the table's own columns.

options.label: 학생증 → 사원증 · ID to Badge
options.lineage: the student ID card and the employee badge, the two plastic cards of graduating
options.thesis: Two cards face each other, a student ID and an employee badge, and credits pass between them.
options.viewport: Two cards at object scale in the first viewport, a seeker ID on the left and a specialist badge on the right, credits animating between them; each card carries its own primary action.
options.risk: Familiar: a two-card hero is where most runs land for this product, and card objects drift toward the generic fintech look.

options.label: Code Cascade Terminal
options.thesis: Hangul and digits rain over black; specialists surface as wireframe panes.
options.viewport: A canvas of falling glyphs with one pane frozen to legibility.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a graduate seeking 자소서 help does not identify with hacker fiction, and falling glyphs hide prices.
options.kept: One material owning the whole viewport.

options.label: Game Boy Four-Shade Field
options.thesis: Specialists listed in bordered menu boxes at one pixel size.
options.viewport: A 160×144 frame with a blinking arrow at the next step.
options.case: Violates the no-playful-tone commitment outright, and one type size cannot carry a credit ledger.
options.kept: A tiny exact palette with hierarchy by inversion and borders.

options.label: Pickling Brine Calendar
options.lineage: seasonal fermentation jars on shelf lines
options.thesis: Specialists as jars maturing with each review.
options.viewport: Jars on shelf lines, labels banded with reviews and day counts.
options.case: Reputation-as-maturation is a metaphor, not a grammar the audience reads; credits and prices have no jar.
options.kept: A fixed data band on every item.
options.risk: Cute where the brief wants minimal.

options.label: Crank Paper Menagerie
options.thesis: A crank drives a procession where a seeker hands a credit to a specialist.
options.viewport: One figure per viewport, a crank line ruling the base.
options.case: Whimsy reads playful, which the brief forbids; the linkage dramatizes the exchange but clarifies nothing about price.
options.kept: One timeline driving every motion, reversible and inspectable.
options.risk: Craft-fair charm on a job-market product.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal Midnight
options.thesis: The landing typed out as one 80-column transcript.
options.viewport: A blinking cursor and a transcript that prints its own states.
options.case: The late-night scene matches, but a monospace transcript is a developer idiom, and monospaced Hangul tables read badly.
options.kept: States printed as content, never as chrome.

options.label: ASCII Live Scene
options.thesis: The 선배 handshake rendered as glyph density.
options.viewport: A live glyph grid the camera moves through.
options.case: A spectacle with no place for a table, a price, or a booking; nobody in the audience reads it as theirs.
options.kept: One strict grid as the entire composition.
options.risk: Demo trick, not a product surface.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The mentoring-platform landing: headline, search bar, mentor photo cards, three benefit cards, testimonials, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and search over a row of mentor cards, three benefit cards, a testimonial band, a sign-up footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design, and it wants testimonials the product does not have.
